body.x: LandingZONE(www.landingzone.net) 'DOCK' 15-inch MacBook Pro was unveiled at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

It's an adaptive and simple to use secure docking station for the Macbook Pro® with Retina display. It lightness and supports and HDMI monitor. Also it can connect a any monitor, hard drive, printer, CD/DVD drive, smart phone, tablet, etc anywhere.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
